DISCOVER THE CAPITAL OF CULTURE & LUXURY

A Full-Day Exploration of the UAE's Grandest Architectural Marvels

While Dubai dazzles with futuristic speed and energetic record-breaking attractions, the capital city of Abu Dhabi invites visitors into a world of regal grandeur, timeless Islamic architecture, and tranquil coastal avenues. On our Abu Dhabi City Tour from Dubai, you travel in absolute luxury aboard a private vehicle, taking in the full sweep of the UAE capital with tailored stops and zero rush.

The crown jewel of your journey is an immersive visit to the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque—one of the world's largest mosques, featuring 82 pure white marble domes, 24-karat gold-plated Swarovski chandeliers, and the world's largest hand-knotted Persian carpet.

Key Attractions on Your Abu Dhabi Itinerary

🕌 Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque

Marvel at reflective water pools, marble floral inlays, intricate calligraphy, and the mesmerizing golden hour glow on the domes.

🏰 Emirates Palace Mandarin Oriental

Admire the Arabian fantasy architecture of this ultra-luxurious palace, with option to sip the legendary 24K gold-flake cappuccino.

🏖️ Abu Dhabi Corniche & Breakwater

Take in sweeping skyline vistas across turquoise waters and capture postcard panoramic photos of downtown Abu Dhabi.

🏛️ Heritage Village & Dates Market

Step back into nomadic desert life with traditional stone huts, Bedouin tents, camel enclosures, and sample authentic Emirati dates.

🎨 Louvre Abu Dhabi (Saadiyat Island)

Admire Jean Nouvel's floating dome creating the famous "rain of light" effect, housing centuries of global art and archaeological treasures.

🏎️ Yas Island & Ferrari World

Stop at the iconic crimson Ferrari World roof and Yas Marina F1 Circuit for high-octane motorsport souvenir photos.

⚠️ Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque Dress Code Guidelines

The Grand Mosque maintains strict modesty protocols. Please ensure adherence prior to boarding the vehicle:

  • Women: Must cover hair with a headscarf/shayla, and wear loose, opaque long sleeves and ankle-length pants or skirts. Tight jeans, leggings, and white transparent fabrics are not permitted.
  • Men: Must wear shirts with sleeves and long trousers. Shorts, sleeveless vests, and tight gym wear are strictly forbidden.
  • Shoes: You will remove your shoes upon entering the interior prayer halls. Clean socks are recommended.

Frequently Asked Questions

What time do we get picked up from Dubai?

We typically recommend pickup between 08:30 AM and 09:00 AM from your hotel lobby in Dubai. This allows you to arrive at the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque before midday heat and avoid peak tour bus crowds.

Is mosque entry included in the tour price?

Yes, general entry to the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is free. Our driver assists you with the digital registration pass and guides your group to the entrance visitor center.

Can we combine this tour with Dubai desert safari?

Because Abu Dhabi is a full-day commitment (around 9–10 hours), we advise scheduling your Dubai Desert Safari on a separate day. For a shorter Dubai sightseeing experience, explore our Dubai City Tour.
